claim_text: We continued our progress on decarbonisation throughout FY25.
metric_name: North Star Junction solar farm capacity; Iron Bridge current power requirements met by renewable energy; High voltage transmission infrastructure added; Total high-voltage transmission infrastructure; Electric excavators operational; Electric drill operational
context_text: We continued our progress on decarbonisation throughout FY25.；This included commissioning a 100MW solar farm at North Star Junction, which is now supplying around 25% of Iron Bridge’s current power requirements with renewable energy.；As part of the Pilbara Energy Connect (PEC) program, we delivered an additional 140km of high voltage transmission infrastructure, bringing the total network to 460km.；Site electrification also advanced, supported by the deployment of seven electric excavators and one electric drill, with more zero-emissions mobile equipment due in FY26.；Additionally, Fortescue’s prototype electric haul truck “Europa” arrived at Christmas Creek for site-based testing and construction is also underway on a 190MW solar farm at Cloudbreak.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 报告提供了多项FY2025已完成或已部署的脱碳里程碑，能够直接证明公司在FY2025持续推进了脱碳工作。
notes: 证据合并自同页多项实际进展。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company made continued progress on decarbonisation during FY25. The provided evidence lists several FY25-relevant actions/outputs that plausibly relate to decarbonisation—e.g., 100MW solar farm capacity, 25% of Iron Bridge current power requirements met by renewable energy, and deployment of electric equipment (7 electric excavators and 1 electric drill). However, the evidence does not explicitly tie these figures to FY25 (no dates/timeframe shown), does not show change versus a prior period (so “continued progress” is not verified), and does not quantify decarbonisation outcomes (e.g., emissions reductions, avoided emissions, or progress against a decarbonisation target).
